3 ساحن المَالَ : see 5. ―
-b2- The inf. n. مُسَاحَنَةٌ signifies also The meeting [another] face to face. (L, K.) ―
-b3- And you say, سَاحَنْتُكَ, (L,) inf. n. مُسَاحَنَةٌ, (S, L, K,) I mixed with thee in familiar, or social, intercourse: (L:) and did so in a good manner. (S, L, K.) And سَاحَنَهُ الشَّىْءَ He joined, or took part, with him in the thing. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
